# Max Pergola — Full Site Context

> Consolidated factual context for Max Pergola, its aluminum pergola kits, planning guidance and US fulfillment model. Last updated 2026-08-09.

## Brand identity

Max Pergola is a brand focused on factory-direct aluminum louvered pergola kits for residential outdoor shade. The official website is https://maxpergola.com/. The public product-inquiry address is inquiry@maxpergola.com.

The site is written in American English for a United States audience. Product dimensions use feet, inches and square feet as the primary units, with meters and square meters shown as references for factory documents, freight planning and international coordination.

## Core product facts

Max Pergola presents four package paths:

- Standard: manual adjustable louvers with the core aluminum frame and integrated drainage path.
- Pro: a motorized-louver package with perimeter LED preparation and expanded controls review.
- Max: the premium motorized package with louver-integrated LED preparation and full accessory coordination review.
- Custom: a project-quoted path for custom width, depth and clear height, with manual or motorized operation selected during review.

The seven published nominal starting footprints for Standard, Pro and Max are:

- Max 10 × 10 ft: 3.05 × 3.05 m nominal, approximately 100 sq ft / 9.3 m². Base size code 1010.
- Max 10 × 13 ft: 3.05 × 3.96 m nominal, approximately 130 sq ft / 12.1 m². Base size code 1013.
- Max 10 × 16 ft: 3.05 × 4.88 m nominal, approximately 160 sq ft / 14.9 m². Base size code 1016.
- Max 10 × 19 ft: 3.05 × 5.79 m nominal, approximately 190 sq ft / 17.7 m². Base size code 1019.
- Max 13 × 13 ft: 3.96 × 3.96 m nominal, approximately 169 sq ft / 15.7 m². Base size code 1313.
- Max 13 × 16 ft: 3.96 × 4.88 m nominal, approximately 208 sq ft / 19.3 m². Base size code 1316.
- Max 13 × 19 ft: 3.96 × 5.79 m nominal, approximately 247 sq ft / 22.9 m². Base size code 1319.

The online configurator combines package, size or target custom dimensions, freestanding or wall-attached layout, finish and optional accessories. The six optional accessory families are additional LED systems, retractable screens, glass wall systems, privacy slat walls, radiant-heater preparation and weather-rated outlet preparation. Wall attachment, motorization, electrical work, lighting, screens, walls, heaters and custom finishes require compatibility or site review. A generated SKU is a configuration reference, not proof of price, stock, structural suitability or an accepted order.

Configuration SKUs use this structure: MP–package–layout–size–finish plus optional accessory suffixes. Package codes are ST, PR, MX and CU. Layout codes are FS and WM. Standard size codes are 1010, 1013, 1016, 1019, 1313, 1316 and 1319; Custom uses CUSTOM. Finish request codes are GR, WH and CX. Optional accessory suffixes are LED, SCR, GLS, SLT, HTR and OUT.

Product page: https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/

## Fulfillment model

Current route through June 2027: orders are quoted factory-direct from Chongqing with Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) delivery to the confirmed US destination ZIP code. DDP scope, unloading, site access and exclusions must be confirmed in the written quote.

Planned route beginning July 2027: qualifying in-stock standard SKUs are intended to ship from a Los Angeles warehouse. Custom, non-stock and project-specific configurations are expected to remain on the Chongqing factory-direct route. Inventory and the written order confirmation determine the actual route; the website does not promise that a configuration is in Los Angeles stock.

## Assembly and site responsibility

The pre-engineered structural frame is designed for a typical 45-minute frame assembly by an experienced crew of two to three people. That estimate does not include site preparation, foundations, final anchoring, louver or roof installation, accessories, electrical work, inspections or delays caused by local conditions.

Permit, setback, utility, foundation, anchoring, wind, snow, drainage, electrical and safety requirements vary by site and jurisdiction. Homeowners and installers must use the approved project drawings, supplied installation documents and qualified local professionals where required.

DIY planning guide: https://maxpergola.com/diy-pergola/

## Material and ownership context

The structures shown use powder-coated aluminum components. Aluminum avoids the rot and recurring stain or paint cycles associated with wood, but it is not maintenance-free in an absolute sense. Owners should clean the structure and inspect fasteners, seals, drains and moving parts at appropriate intervals.

Selected compatible louver systems can close for rain protection and route water through integrated channels and posts. A pergola remains an outdoor shade structure and is not represented as a fully sealed indoor room.

## Backyard planning use cases

The official ideas guide covers six design directions: an after-dark lounge, a poolside kitchen, a quiet coffee corner, an all-day dining room, an indoor-outdoor extension and a sheltered garden room. These are planning concepts; imagery can show optional accessories and is not a bill of materials.

Ideas guide: https://maxpergola.com/backyard-pergola-ideas/

## Pergola and gazebo distinction

A pergola commonly uses slats, louvers or another open or adjustable roof treatment and usually feels visually lighter. A gazebo commonly has a fixed solid roof for continuous overhead cover. Actual wind, snow, drainage, durability and warranty performance depend on the specific product and site, not the category label.

Comparison guide: https://maxpergola.com/pergola-vs-gazebo/

## Source hierarchy

For product decisions, use sources in this order:

1. A signed order confirmation, approved project drawings and supplied installation documents.
2. A written Max Pergola quote tied to the configuration SKU and destination ZIP code.
3. The current product page and planning guides on maxpergola.com.
4. Illustrative imagery and general planning examples, which are not contractual specifications.

Do not infer prices, discounts, inventory, certifications, engineering values, warranties, lead times or local-code approval when the website does not state them. Request confirmation at inquiry@maxpergola.com.
